result.summary: The page is largely well-structured. One notable visual inconsistency: in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) is taller/positioned higher than the neighboring cards, causing vertical misalignment of the card images, titles, and delivery-fee text across the row.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the first card's image sits higher and is taller than the second and third cards, so the card titles ('Green Bowl Poké' vs 'Smash Bros Burgers' vs 'Trattoria Piccol...') and the delivery-fee lines do not align on a common baseline across the row.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed, equal image height and align titles/metadata to a consistent baseline so the row reads as a uniform grid.
